title: load status classes this clone's own processes started by a relative script path as another clone
goal: mon_host.kind_of gives a process whose script path is relative (python3 _tools/kbmon.py, ./_tools/tests.py, a pytest run of a relative test path) the clone this or unknown, never other, so --status load does not report this clone's own kbmon or tests as another clone's load

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import mon_host; assert mon_host.kind_of('python3 _tools/kbmon.py --status','/x')[1] != 'other'
